overview: The Medford City Council met to consider business sign appeals, commend the Medford Arts Council, and address traffic safety concerns in South Medford. The Council also voted on resolutions concerning public library funding, meeting transparency, parking enforcement complaints, and heavy trucking enforcement.

items.title: Sign Denial Reversal for 321 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved a sign denial reversal for Tasty Cafe on the Hill at 321 Boston Avenue to allow a non-conforming awning.

items.title: Commendation of Medford Arts Council
items.summary: Approved resolutions commending the Medford Arts Council for being named 2016 Council of the Year by the Massachusetts Cultural Council and requesting increased municipal budget funding.

items.title: South Medford Traffic and Parking Safety
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution requesting directed police patrols, temporary barriers or signage, an on-site Committee of the Whole meeting, and Traffic Commission action regarding illegal truck parking at Harvard and Main Streets.

items.title: Main Street Bus Stop Relocation
items.summary: Referred a proposal to temporarily relocate the bus stop from 17-19 Main Street to Riverside Avenue to the Council Transportation Committee and the Traffic Commission.

items.title: Advanced Manufacturing Vocational Courses
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that Medford Vocational Technical High School explore offering evening courses in advanced manufacturing training for local residents.

items.title: Police and Fire Department Operational Updates
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution requesting administrative updates on operational plans for the Police and Fire Departments, including fire interdepartmental email and police female locker room construction.

items.title: Website Postings of Board and Commission Meetings
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution requiring all city boards and commissions to post meeting notices, agendas, and minutes online, schedule meetings outside normal business hours, and stream meetings when possible.

items.title: Public Library Funding and Repairs
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution inviting state library representatives to discuss funding opportunities for public library repairs and requesting an administrative report on roof repair plans.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Report on Cradock Bridge Project
items.summary: Approved the Committee of the Whole report on Cradock Bridge construction impacts, which recommended an ADA audit, a designated municipal point person, and state project updates.

items.title: Republic Parking Enforcement Complaints
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution seeking responses from Republic Parking regarding ticketing during church services, daycare drop-off leniency, and Marion Street parking rules.

items.title: Payphone Pedestal Removal Clarification
items.summary: Referred a response regarding inactive payphone pedestals back to the Superintendent of Wires for further clarification.

items.title: Spring Street Heavy Trucking Enforcement
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution requesting enforcement of heavy trucking bans on Spring Street, consideration of a police truck enforcement unit, and Mystic River safety patrols.

items.title: Meeting Minutes Approval
items.summary: Approved the records of the previous week's meeting.
